# Vloombox
> AI resume optimizer, live tech jobs board (refreshed through the day from ~500 companies), DSA/LLD/HLD interview prep, and referrals.

## Primary pages
- https://www.vloombox.in/ : Live tech jobs board (last 24 hours only)
- https://www.vloombox.in/optimizer : AI resume tailoring for a specific job description
- https://www.vloombox.in/dsa : DSA interview questions by company
- https://www.vloombox.in/lld : Low-level design interview problems
- https://www.vloombox.in/hld : High-level system design practice
- https://www.vloombox.in/interview : Interview question bank
- https://www.vloombox.in/pricing : Free, Pro, and Max plans
- https://www.vloombox.in/about : About Vloombox
- https://www.vloombox.in/faq : FAQ
- https://www.vloombox.in/blog : Blog
